text.title: Gate Failure Contract — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: a Gate Failure Contract (GFC) as YAML or JSON, one per gate, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: The gate's name as an operator would say it, e.g. "uk prose judge" or "corpus validator sweep".

What does the evaluating. `static` reads bytes; `trigger-eval` calls the system and compares mechanically; `judge` calls a model to score; `manual` is a person reading. Determines which non-evaluating modes are mandatory.
The exact command a runner executes. A gate with no invocation line is configured, not run (r5-configured-is-not-invoked).
How the verdict leaves the gate. `findings` requires `blocking_severity`.
The severity at or above which the gate's own threshold blocks. Required when `verdict_channel` includes findings; the synthetic ERROR finding must be emitted at this level.

One entry per non-evaluating mode. Each item: `mode` (one of `parse`, `refusal`, `truncation`, `transport`, `empty`, `crash`, `absent_input`), `detect` (the observable that identifies it), `emits` (the synthetic finding rule id, or `exit:N`), and `severity`. For `instrument: judge` all five model modes are mandatory; for `trigger-eval`, all except `refusal`; for `static`, `crash` and `absent_input`.
Code paths audited out of existence, quoted with file and line — e.g. `except json.JSONDecodeError: return []`. Names what was removed so a reviewer can grep for its return.
Keys: `allowed` (bool), and when true also `flag`, `expires` (ISO date), `logged` (bool, must be true). When `allowed: false` no other key is needed (r6-override-is-explicit-logged-and-expiring).

The command that breaks the gate on purpose and the exit code it must then produce, e.g. "FAION_JUDGE_FORCE=parse-error make lint → expect exit 1". A contract without this asserts fail-closed; this demonstrates it.
ISO date the fault-injection proof was last run green. A proof nobody re-runs decays into a claim.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: Every `mode` mandatory for the declared `instrument` is present exactly once. No `emits` value is `pass`, `ignore`, `warn`, `none`, `exit:0` or empty. When `verdict_channel` includes findings, every mode's `severity` is at or above `blocking_severity` on the ordering critical > high > medium > low. `degraded_override.allowed: true` requires `flag`, `logged: true` and an `expires` date that is not in the past relative to `last_proved`. `fault_injection_proof` and `last_proved` are both present and non-empty.

section.title: Scope note
section.statement: This contract governs what a gate does when it CANNOT evaluate. It does not govern what the gate should check, which rung it belongs on, or what threshold it blocks at — see `verification-rung-placement-rule` for instrument choice and `model-eval-control-bands` for thresholds. A gate can be perfectly placed, perfectly thresholded, and still report pass because it was dead.
